ideas.pitch: A high-performance C++20 order-matching engine optimized for cache locality and minimal latency, built specifically for HFT evaluation harness constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: Low Latency Trading Experience: Implement an order-matching engine in engine.cpp using C++20 standard library that handles limit, market, cancel, FOK, IOC orders, and self-trade prevention with minimal latency.
ideas.title: UltraLowLatencyEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the core technical evaluation directly by combining cache-conscious data structures with strict C++20 standard library conformance, matching what HFT judges and IICPC mentors look for.

ideas.pitch: An order book implementation utilizing flat memory layouts and custom allocators within the C++20 standard library to eliminate heap fragmentation during high-frequency event streaming.
ideas.problem_statement: Low Latency Trading Experience: Go fast and ensure correctness on an evaluation harness streaming high-volume order events into an engine.cpp implementation.
ideas.title: CacheAlignedBook
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard systems engineering and advanced memory management techniques that directly target the live latency leaderboard.

ideas.pitch: An order matching engine featuring strict pre-trade self-trade prevention checks and immediate IOC/FOK execution logic implemented with zero dynamic allocations in the hot path.
ideas.problem_statement: Low Latency Trading Experience: An evaluation harness streams order events into your engine: limit and market orders, cancels, fill-or-kill and IOC orders, and self-trade prevention.
ideas.title: DeterministicRiskGateEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Prioritizes correct edge-case handling for complex order types (FOK/IOC) before micro-optimizations, ensuring top placement on correctness stages.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined C++20 matching core designed around contiguous storage vectors rather than node-based trees to maximize CPU cache hits during continuous order matching.
ideas.problem_statement: Low Latency Trading Experience: Build your own order-matching engine in a hands-on session with the IICPC team using C++20 standard library only.
ideas.title: VectorizedMatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns precisely with the hardware-conscious engineering mindset valued in quant/HFT technical screenings hosted by Ayush Kumar and the IICPC team.

ideas.pitch: A robust single-file engine.cpp implementation optimized for ultra-fast cancellation and rapid limit order lookup without relying on external dependencies.
ideas.problem_statement: Low Latency Trading Experience: Implement one function, create_engine(), in a single file (engine.cpp) using the C++20 standard library only, passing visible unit tests and hidden streams.
ideas.title: ZeroOverheadOrderFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Strict adherence to the single-file constraint combined with thorough unit test coverage guarantees immediate baseline correctness on the leaderboard.
